children: Oil futures edge higher in early Asian trade on a likely technical recovery after settling overnight at their lowest level since August. Oil futures may also be supported by signs of increasing hostilities in the Middle East that could lead to supply disruptions. "Iran continues to attack vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, with [President] Trump announcing it has launched more drones and missiles in the last week than at any time of over the year," ANZ Research analysts say in a note. Front-month WTI crude oil futures are 0.2% higher at $80.31 a barrel. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
